description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes for the TinySRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication system, including password and configuration management, cryptographic utilities, and system integration functions.

methods.name: t_getprecount
methods.description: Returns the number of precompiled parameter sets for SRP.

methods.name: t_getpreparam
methods.description: Retrieves a specific precompiled SRP parameter set by index.

methods.name: t_openconf
methods.description: Opens a configuration file stream for reading SRP parameters.

methods.name: t_openconfbyname
methods.description: Opens a configuration file by filename for SRP parameters.

methods.name: t_closeconf
methods.description: Closes an open SRP configuration file.

methods.name: t_rewindconf
methods.description: Resets the configuration file stream to the beginning.

methods.name: t_getconfent
methods.description: Fetches the next configuration entry from the SRP config file.

methods.name: t_getconfbyindex
methods.description: Fetches a configuration entry by index from the SRP config file.

methods.name: t_getconflast
methods.description: Fetches the last configuration entry in the SRP config file.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Generates a new configuration entry with random parameters.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Creates a configuration entry with specific parameters.

methods.name: t_newconfent
methods.description: Returns an empty configuration entry.

methods.name: t_cmpconfent
methods.description: Compares two configuration entries.

methods.name: t_checkconfent
methods.description: Verifies if a configuration entry's parameters are valid.

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Writes a configuration entry to a stream.

methods.name: gettcent
methods.description: Accesses the system's SRP configuration entries.

methods.name: gettcid
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration entry by ID.

methods.name: settcent
methods.description: Sets the current system SRP configuration context.

methods.name: endtcent
methods.description: Ends the system SRP configuration context.

methods.name: gettpent
methods.description: Reads the next password file entry.

methods.name: gettpnam
methods.description: Looks up a password file entry by username.

methods.name: settpent
methods.description: Resets the password file reading position.

methods.name: endtpent
methods.description: Closes the password file.

methods.name: t_verifypw
methods.description: Verifies a username and password against the system password file.

methods.name: t_changepw
methods.description: Changes a user's password in the system password file.

methods.name: t_deletepw
methods.description: Deletes a user from the system password file.

methods.name: t_tohex
methods.description: Converts binary data to hexadecimal string.

methods.name: t_fromhex
methods.description: Converts hexadecimal string to binary data.

methods.name: t_tob64
methods.description: Encodes binary data to base64.

methods.name: t_fromb64
methods.description: Decodes base64 string to binary data.

methods.name: t_random
methods.description: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: t_stronginitrand
methods.description: Initializes the random number generator.

methods.name: t_sessionkey
methods.description: Generates a session key from hash inputs.

methods.name: t_getpass
methods.description: Reads a password from terminal input without echo.

methods.name: t_checkprime
methods.description: Checks if a number is prime and safe for cryptographic use.
